verdict.rationale: Zoho Books documents automatic bank-feed import with categorization and a Bank Rules API (create/update/reorder rules, match filters) plus Zia AI 'categorizing bank statements' and anomaly detection, which supports auto-suggested categorization during reconciliation. However, no evidence describes a machine-learning suggestion engine that specifically learns from user corrections over time (as opposed to static, user-authored rules). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of adaptive/ML-based suggestion learning from corrections, and independent/hands-on confirmation of accuracy improving over time.
